Atraxa.mana: One white, one blue, one black and one green mana.
abilities: At the beginning of your end step, proliferate: choose any number of permanents and/or players and add one more counter of every kind already on each.
Proliferate grows existing counters; it cannot place the first counter of a new kind.
Atraxa.use: Seed useful counters before your end step, then keep Atraxa protected so each turn compounds them. Vigilance lets her pressure an opponent while remaining available to block.

Krenko.mana: Two generic and two red mana.
abilities: Tap Krenko to create 1/1 red Goblin tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control when the ability resolves.
Krenko is a Goblin, so he contributes to that count while on the battlefield.
This is an activated ability, not a trigger. Summoning sickness prevents tapping him for it unless he has haste.
Krenko.use: Build a Goblin board first, then use haste or a protected activation window to multiply it. Turn those tokens into damage while keeping a way to rebuild after a wipe.

Shadrix.mana: Three generic, one white and one black mana.
abilities: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may choose two different modes, each targeting a different player. Shadrix does not need to attack.
A player creates a flying 2/1 Inkling; draws a card and loses 1 life; or puts a +1/+1 counter on each creature they control.
Shadrix.use: Give yourself the mode your board needs most and offer a different player the least dangerous benefit. Counters build Shadrix’s double-strike threat; decline the optional choices when both would help opponents too much.

Chulane.mana: Two generic, one green, one white and one blue mana.
abilities: Whenever you cast a creature spell, draw a card, then you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield. This triggers on casting, not on entering.
Pay three generic mana and tap Chulane to return a target creature you control to its owner’s hand.
Chulane.use: Sequence inexpensive creatures to draw and develop lands. When the mana is worthwhile, return and recast a useful creature to repeat its value while retaining protection for Chulane.
